survey: 2022 Commodity Flow Survey Public Use Microdata
notes: Publisher randomly assigned SHIPMT_ID after sorting records. Our first-100-file-prefix subset is not a documented independent probability sample and is not cleared for national estimates.
SHIPMT_VALUE denotes shipment goods value, not billed transportation.
WGT_FACTOR survey design weight; do not sum sample unweighted or claim national results.
No original actual customer invoice or carrier agreement.
Full 677MB source was not downloaded; ZIP central directory was independently read using byte-range requests.

original_2022_pums_source_population.shipment_value_unit: USD of goods shipped, not freight rate

weight_policy.interpretation: shipment tabulation weighting factor accounts for survey design, subsampling, poststratification and disclosure-avoidance adjustments

disclosure_policy.description: PUMS records may include topcoding, noise infusion, truncation, rounding and geographic/commodity collapsing

qualification_of_extracted_prefix: Deterministic first 100 records in the publisher's randomly ordered 37,576,546-row PUMS; not a new, independently designed sample suitable for weighted population estimates.
